title: Share & Earn
explainer: Your username is your referral tag. Share any page with #username appended — tagged traffic, signups, and assisted sales earn credits.
heroTerms: Your username is appended to every link you share (as #username). Credits ({unit}) accrue from tagged traffic that converts — people who visit resources with your tag and sign up on the platform.
heroCommission: If a vendor has assisted-sales commission bonuses and a buyer purchases with your referral tag, you receive {unit} according to that seller’s terms.
tagHint: Copy any page URL with your tag, or share the home link below. Format: site/path#yourname
needUsername: Set a username in Profile to activate Share & Earn. Your username becomes your referral tag.
noWallets: Set a username to get your share link.
shareText: Check this out — use my link.
loadError: Could not load your referral dashboard. Try again shortly.
visitsExplainer: Visits on resources shared with your referral tag.
